p-series-partial-sums.alt: Partial sums of the sum of 1 over n to the p, for n = 1 to 40 and three values of p, one dot per partial sum. p = 1/2, vermillion: the sums climb steeply, 11.27 by n = 40, and grow without bound. p = 1, the harmonic series, blue: the sums climb slowly, 4.28 by n = 40, but still grow without bound. p = 2, emerald: the sums level off under the dashed line at π²/6, about 1.645. The series converges exactly when p is greater than 1.
